messages:
Amira (Marketing): heads-up — our Open House (benchmark deep-dive + live demo) is set for Thu 3/26 10am PT. Need final check on reg page CTA variants + Zoom recording/clip plan.
Sam - Events: linking the latest reg page mock: https://airtable.com/shrExample/registration
Sam - Events: primary CTA = 'Save my seat' / alt CTA = 'Get the replay' — want to A/B for conversion and replay opt-ins.
Jess (Content): prefer primary CTA to emphasize agenda (benchmarks) — 'See the benchmark results' seems higher intent. will draft copy today.
Ryan (Growth): please make sure UTM params come through so we can attribute leads in Growth stack. utm_source=open-house, utm_campaign=mar26-bench
Kai - Ops: Zoom notes: cloud recording + auto-transcribe ON, record active speaker + gallery, cloud recording to S3 via our RTMP fallback if cloud fails. Also enable "Only authenticated users can join" = off for public, but enable waiting room.
Kai - Ops: panelist pass for demo: zoom role: panelist, send DTLS notes to panelists by EOD.
Amira (Marketing): tagging @Sam @Kai: replay needs to be clipped into 3 assets (highlights, demo clip, full replay) within 24h, captions and transcript within 48h. Who owns clips?
Sam - Events: I'll own clip ops. coordinating with video-edit freelance (Lina). Will push raw cloud recording to S3 path: s3://redwood-recordings/open-house/1765512345_replay.mp4 and create clips there.
Sam - Events: command for ops to use when moving from Zoom export -> s3: 
```
aws s3 cp "zoom_1765512345_cloud_recording.mp4" s3://redwood-recordings/open-house/1765512345_replay.mp4 --acl private
```
Kai - Ops: noted. We'll run a post-recording job to generate transcript + VTT. Also will set lifecycle: raw -> 90d, clips -> 365d.
Jess (Content): post-event cadence: 1) 6h: replay + short highlight clip + transcript link 2) 48h: extended writeup + benchmark summary 3) 7d: targeted follow-up for attendees who watched >=50%. Need lead routing rules.
Ryan (Growth): routing: use Zapier webhook to SFDC lead create + tag mapping. sample payload: 
```
POST https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/xxx/yyy
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "first_name": "{{first_name}}",
  "utm_source": "open-house",
  "utm_campaign": "mar26-bench",
  "reg_source": "open-house-3-26"
}
```
Ryan (Growth): map attendees -> Campaign "Open House Mar26" and add field 'watched_pct' when we get video analytics. If watched_pct >= 50 -> add tag 'watched_50' and route to SDR queue A.
Amira (Marketing): note consent: reg page must include checkbox: "I agree to receive product updates and event replays" (unchecked by default). Legal sign-off? @Kai
Kai - Ops: Legal approved default language. We'll include hidden input for marketing_optin and pass it to Zap payload. Also add field reg_origin = landing_v1 / linkedin_ad etc.
Jess (Content): can we add one-sentence preview to confirmation email and link to calendar ICS? also please include meeting room info for panelists.
Sam - Events: yes — confirmation email draft: short agenda + add to calendar button + note "recording will be shared".
ops-bot: Zoom cloud recording completed and uploaded to s3://redwood-recordings/open-house/1765512345_replay.mp4 (auto message). :white_check_mark:
Kai - Ops: ops-bot confirmed. I'll kick off clipping job and VTT generation, ETA ~3 hours.
Sam - Events: Lina will start editing highlights as soon as clips available. Jess will approve copy for replay email.
Amira (Marketing): final checklist for launch: reg page live ✅, CTA A/B flags enabled ✅, Zoom config ✅, Zapier webhook test ✅, clips owner assigned ✅. Any blockers?
Ryan (Growth): one small ask — track first-touch campaign + last-touch for paid channels. I'll validate mapping in GA and SFDC tomorrow AM.
Jess (Content): I'll post the replay + highlights to the blog + newsletter after approval.
Amira (Marketing): great — thanks team. Will follow up with short recap and timing once clips are in. :rocket:
